note: The plan has its own big words on the titles line and small text on the NOW row, with captions only elsewhere. Use these only if more is asked for, and never on top of the plan's text.

mg.title: All these titles

text.main: all these different titles that have placed on me

mg.use: Short full-frame card as he says it, before the INMATE and GANG MEMBER words. Then back to the B-roll of the men.

mg.title: Claim my name
mg.use: Over Gonzalo on camera as he says it, after the INMATE and GANG MEMBER words fade off.

mg.title: Break bread

text.main: people who came from the outside were able to sit with us, shake hands with us, break bread with us.

mg.use: Over the handshake B-roll as he says it. Keep captions on, low in the frame.

mg.title: Focus on the handshake
mg.use: Brackets around the handshake in the B-roll. Move them to where the hands meet.

mg.title: FTC color wipe
mg.use: Only if you need a beat from the B-roll back to his face at 00:30. Cut at the middle of the wipe. Use it once.

mg.title: The last day

text.main: I knew Sunday was going to be the last day.

mg.use: Over Gonzalo as he says it. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Compassion was a gift

text.main: this compassion that Freedom to Choose gave to me was a gift.

mg.use: Over his face on the first sentence only. Off before “share this gift”, then hold on his face.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: One line first, 3 seconds: “Join our journey.” Then the end card: the FTC logo + “Change from the Inside” + the donation link.
